name: betraying-blade-on-attack-pay-two-prep-counter
notes: Betraying Blade (qwxvzfkpaj, WIND ATTACK, reserve 2, power 2): "On Attack: You may pay (2). If you do, put a preparation counter on your champion." Player 1 ends turn 1 (first-player attack lock), then player 2 plays Betraying Blade from hand for real (two reserve payments), picks player 1's champion as the target, and the On Attack trigger (onAttackAbilities['qwxvzfkpaj:0'] -> customDQHandlers['qwxvzfkpaj:0:OnAttack-1']) asks player 2 whether to pay (2); player 2 holds 7+ cards. Player 2's champion is the Material-section Spirit of Wind, so WIND needs no lineage patch. Answering YES queues two ReserveCard payments (each moves a hand card to memory) and adds the preparation counter to the attacker's champion; the combat damage (2) still lands on player 1's champion.

rulesClauses: On Attack: You may pay (2). If you do, put a preparation counter on your champion.
